title: Gin N Juice
original_lyrics:
[verse]
Pretty easy song to play. Basically playing the same Bass Line all the way through. I
wanted to include version on UG because people like to have all their music and lyrics
(And you can walk the bass line back up: )
With so much drama in the L...
It's kinda hard bein' Snoop -O-double-

[bridge]
Keep comin' up with funky ass shit like every single day
May I kick little something for the 's?
And, make few ends as I breeze through-
Two in the mornin' and the party's still jumpin'
'Cause my momma ain't home
I got bitches in the living room gettin' it on
And, they ain't leavin' 'til six in the mornin'
So what you wanna do? Shit, I got pocket
Full of rubbers and my homeboys do too
So turn off the lights and close the doors

[bridge]
So we gonna smoke ounce to this
's up, hoes down, while you motherfuckers bounce to this
Rollin' down the street, smokin' endo

With my mind on my money
And my money on my mind

Sippin' on gin and juice, laid back
With my mind on my money
And my money on my mind
Now that I got me some Seagram's gin
Everybody got they cups, but they ain't chipped in
Now this type of shit happens all the time
You got to get yours but fool I gotta get mine
Everything is fine when you listenin' to the -O-
I got the cultivating music that be captivating he
Who listens, to the words that I speak
As I take me drink to the middle of the street
And get to mackin' to this bitch named Sadie
She used to be the homeboys lady
(Oh, that bitch?)
Eighty degrees, when I tell that bitch please
Raise up off these N-U-T's, 'cause you gets none of these
At ease, as I mob with the Dogg Pound, feel the breeze

[bridge]
Rollin' down the street, smokin' endo

With my mind on my money

Dr. Dre came through with gang of Tanqueray
And fat ass J of some bubonic chronic
That made me choke, shit, this ain't no joke
I had to back up off of it and sit my cup down
Tanqueray and chronic, yeah, I'm fucked up now

[bridge]
Dre got some bitches from the city of Compton
To serve me, not with cherry on top
'Cause when I bust my nut, I'm raisin' up off the cot
Don't get upset girl, that's just how it goes
